# SoundGen studio tools

82 tools, the same on the MCP server and at `POST /tools/{name}`.
`python3 scripts/soundgen.py tools <name>` prints one with its description and
JSON input schema — read it before calling a tool for the first time.

## Arrangement

Build a song step by step — tracks, instruments, measured audio clips, MIDI clips in bars — or many edits as one atomic save.

`get_arrangement`, `get_track`, `list_clips`, `add_track`, `update_track`, `delete_track`, `list_instruments`, `add_clip`, `add_midi_clip`, `update_clip`, `delete_clip`, `set_tempo`, `apply_edits`, `list_markers`, `add_marker`, `delete_marker`

## MIDI & Automation

Notes in beats, AI-composed parts, automation curves, warp markers and comping.

`list_notes`, `set_notes`, `add_notes`, `delete_notes`, `transpose_notes`, `quantize_notes`, `generate_midi_part`, `list_automation`, `set_automation`, `set_warp_markers`, `list_takes`, `select_take`

## Mixing

Inserts one at a time on any track or the master bus, sends, modulators and master level.

`list_effect_types`, `add_effect`, `update_effect`, `remove_effect`, `set_track_effects`, `set_track_sends`, `set_track_modulators`, `set_master`

## Projects

Create, read and manage projects, their versions and collaborators.

`list_projects`, `get_project`, `create_project`, `update_project`, `delete_project`, `list_project_versions`, `create_project_version`, `list_project_collaborators`, `invite_collaborator`

## Sounds

The sound library: upload, search, tag and delete audio.

`list_sounds`, `get_sound`, `create_sound`, `update_sound`, `delete_sound`, `list_genres`

## AI Generation

Generate audio from a prompt, extend or rewrite a section of a song, and track generation jobs.

`generate_audio`, `edit_song`, `list_generations`, `get_generation`

## Audio Processing

Stem separation, speech and lyrics to text, and the AI audio pipeline (mixing, mastering, cleanup). Paid work is charged server-side, only when it delivers.

`separate_stems`, `transcribe_speech`, `ai_audio_process`

## Voice

Clone a voice from a sample and synthesise speech with it; synthesis returns a link to the stored MP3. Clone and synthesis are charged server-side, only when they deliver.

`list_voices`, `clone_voice`, `synthesize_voice`, `delete_voice`

## AI Musicians

Performer and engineer personas. Pass their ids as generate_audio `musicians` and their style, feel and skills are briefed into the take (never the name); get_ai_musician returns the brief, mix/master plan and part hints. Delete is soft (restore_ai_musician); update can publish or share with a team.

`list_ai_musicians`, `get_ai_musician`, `create_ai_musician`, `update_ai_musician`, `publish_ai_musician`, `delete_ai_musician`, `restore_ai_musician`

## Model Training

Train custom models on your own audio and follow the job.

`list_training_jobs`, `get_training_job`, `create_training_job`, `cancel_training_job`

## Video

A link that opens the free Audio Visualizer with a look and one of your songs; the video is made in the browser, nothing renders server-side.

`visualizer_link`

## Product Knowledge

Search SoundGen's own documentation — what a feature does and how to reach it.

`search_help`, `get_help_topic`, `list_help_topics`

## Account

Profile, credit balance, your invite link and platform statistics.

`get_user_profile`, `update_user_profile`, `get_user_credits`, `get_referral_link`, `get_platform_stats`
